# 🏗️ Architecture Document Template

## Metadata

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| System/feature | |
| Owner | |
| Revision | |
| Status | Draft / Reviewed / Accepted |
| Related ADRs | |

## Goals and non-goals

State what the design must achieve and what is excluded.

## Context and constraints

Describe users, workflows, runtime, scale assumptions, dependencies, privacy requirements, and constraints. Identify assumptions that still require validation.

## Current state versus proposed state

Clearly distinguish what is already implemented from what is being proposed.

## Components and responsibilities

| Component | Responsibility | Interface | Trust level |
|---|---|---|---|
| | | | |

## Architecture diagrams

Include high-level and component diagrams. Add sequence, deployment, data-flow, or state diagrams when they answer a concrete question. Mark future components as proposed.

## Data and interfaces

Document data classification, ownership, schemas, endpoints/events where they exist, validation, failure responses, retention, and deletion. State explicitly when APIs or databases do not exist.

## Security and privacy

Threats, trust boundaries, authentication, authorization, secrets, encryption, audit, external providers, and abuse controls.

## Reliability and operations

Failure modes, retries, timeouts, monitoring, backup, restore, deployment, rollback, and support ownership.

## Alternatives and trade-offs

Record viable options, decision criteria, and rejected alternatives.

## Verification and rollout

List tests, migration steps, rollout strategy, rollback triggers, and acceptance evidence.

## Review record

Reviewers, date, decision, unresolved risks, and follow-up owner:
